chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Muskhan, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"When a man catches the first Takbirah and the two Takbiratayn of the Salat al-Mayyit (prayer over the deceased), he must make up what remains, consecutively."
ai.seo_question: How to complete the funeral prayer if one joins late?
ai.summary: This ruling from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the minimum requirement for valid participation in the funeral prayer, emphasizing that catching the initial Takbir al-Ihram and two subsequent Taksirs constitutes sufficient presence to complete the prayer consecutively. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that the prayer is not fragmented but rather completed as a whole once the essential components are joined, ensuring the validity of the individual's obligation.
